title: L1-sacrum angular change under 1200 N follower preload depending on preload path

quantity.name: angular change under follower preload
quantity.definition: change in L1-sacrum sagittal angle when 0 -> 1200 N follower preload is applied in a fixed posture (posture test); mean (SD)

source.authors: Patwardhan AG, Havey RM, Carandang G, Simonds J, Voronov LI, Ghanayem AJ, Meade KP, Gavin TM, Paxinos O
source.sample: 21 cadaveric L1-sacrum spines (neutral path); 15 of them also with flexed path; human cadaver ligamentous lumbar spines L1-sacrum, mild-moderate degeneration, no bridging osteophytes

protocol.summary: L1 and sacrum potted; neutral posture = top cup ~15 deg extension at 0 N/0 Nm. Flexion-extension moments applied by water flowing into bags on loading arms on the top cup, continuous cycling between 8 Nm flexion and 6 Nm extension (rate 2.8-3.1 Nm/min flexion, 2.2-2.5 Nm/min extension), >= 2 full cycles recorded (analysed cycle not stated). Follower preload 0/200/400/800/1200 N via bilateral cables through guides on L2-sacrum to a hanger; path optimised either for the neutral posture (min lordosis change, 21 specimens) or for a forward-flexed posture at 2/3 of baseline flexion ROM (15 specimens). 5 min between preload increments; load cell under sacrum; Optotrak motion of each vertebra relative to sacrum.
how_to_simulate: Model L1-sacrum, sacrum fixed, L1 free (no moment for neutral posture; ~2.4 Nm (SD 0.6) flexion moment to hold the flexed posture at 2/3 of baseline flexion ROM)
Apply follower preload 0 -> 1200 N along the path optimised for the neutral posture or for the flexed posture
Report the change in the L1-sacrum sagittal angle (lordosis) at 1200 N
protocol.notes: ROM = total L1-sacrum rotation from 8 Nm flexion to 6 Nm extension (not per level). Order of preloads not randomised; 0 N ROM repeated at end in 14 specimens was 8% larger than at start. Per-level ROM not reported. Possible specimen overlap with Renner 2007 (same Loyola/Hines lab and authors; Renner used 10 L1-S1 spines, 7M/3F, mean 58 y) - flagged in shared_sample_with.

data.note: increase in lordosis (extension) at 1200 N; n assumed 21 (all specimens had neutral path) - not stated explicitly

data.load: 1200 N follower, ~2.4 Nm flexion holding moment
1200 N follower, ~2.4 Nm flexion holding moment

extraction.check_notes: Re-read Results paragraph: 0.7 (0.9), 0.1 (1.3), 11 (6.7), 12 (16) deg; holding moment 2.4 (0.6) Nm from Methods. | OK (Results text p.542: 0.7(0.9), 0.1(1.3), 11(6.7), 12(16) deg; n=21/15)

pass_rule.rule: optimised path: |change| <= 1 deg; mismatched path: change of correct sign within 1 SD
